tour.title: Apache Wicket Framework Overview
tour.description: Wicket is a component-based Java web framework that aims to simplify web application development by allowing developers to build web UIs using a model similar to desktop GUI frameworks.

tour.title: Core Framework Architecture
tour.description: The core framework provides the foundation for all Wicket applications, including request handling, component lifecycle, page management, and the model-view binding mechanism.
tour.languageLesson: Java web frameworks use a component model where UI elements (components) maintain their own state and logic. Wicket maps this to HTML markup files paired with Java classes.

tour.title: Building Applications with Wicket
tour.description: Wicket applications extend WebApplication to set up session handling, converters, validators, and other application-wide settings. Pages are the top-level components that represent web pages.

tour.title: Component-Based Development
tour.description: Components are reusable UI building blocks. Wicket provides a rich set of built-in components and allows developers to create custom components by extending existing ones.

tour.title: Data Binding and Models
tour.description: Models in Wicket provide a layer of indirection for accessing and updating data. They support lazy loading, chaining, and integration with various data sources.

tour.title: Wicket Extensions
tour.description: The extensions module provides additional components and utilities beyond the core framework, including AJAX support, tree components, and more advanced UI patterns.

tour.title: Integration with Other Frameworks
tour.description: Wicket integrates seamlessly with popular Java frameworks including Spring and Guice for dependency injection, allowing developers to use their preferred DI container.

tour.title: Testing Wicket Applications
tour.description: Wicket provides WicketTester, a testing utility that allows you to test components and pages without requiring a running web server, making unit testing fast and efficient.
